title: Strict henselization commutes with surjective local quotients
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring, $K$ a separable closure of its residue field, with compatible $A$-algebra and residue-field algebra structures. Let $C$ be an $A$-algebra and assume that $C$ is an algebraic strict henselization of $A$ relative to $K$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let $B$ be a commutative local ring and $\pi:A\to B$ a surjective ring homomorphism with kernel $I\subseteq\mathfrak m_A$. There exist a field $L$ which is a separable closure of the residue field of $B$, compatible residue-field and $B$-algebra structures on $L$, and a $B$-algebra structure on the explicit quotient $C/IC$, where $IC$ is extension under $A\to C$, such that $C/IC$ is an algebraic strict henselization of $B$ relative to $L$.

source.place: Tag 05WS, algebra.tex, lemma-quotient-strict-henselization. The pointed-etale finality argument is written by U2 for the project colimit definition.

proof.text: Choose L = SeparableClosure (ResidueField B). Compose its residue-field algebra map with IsLocalRing.residue B to give the B-action. The composite is definitionally compatible, so IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' supplies the scalar tower. These canonical constructions supply all field and separable-closure structures in the existential conclusion.

Put Q = C/(I.map(algebraMap A C)) and q = Ideal.Quotient.mk _. Rewrite ker(pi) = I; Ideal.le_comap_map gives ker(pi) <= ker(q.comp(algebraMap A C)). Descend q.comp(algebraMap A C) along pi with RingHom.liftOfSurjective to obtain beta : B -> Q. Equip Q with beta.toAlgebra. The compatibility beta.comp(pi) = q.comp(algebraMap A C) follows from RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply.

Apply the adopted upstream IsStrictHenselization.surjective_quotient to the constructed L and compatible B-action on Q. Its proof uses finality of pointed etale base change, preservation of colimits by extension of scalars, and the compatible quotient vertex isomorphism. Package the resulting strict-henselization proof with the field, tower, and quotient structures. This derives exactly the original existential node statement, also for I=0.

lean.statement:
theorem IsStrictHenselization.surjective_quotient
    (A K C B L : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (hC : IsStrictHenselization A K C)
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Field L]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower B (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (I : Ideal A) (hker : RingHom.ker π = I)
    [Algebra B (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))]
    (hcomp : (algebraMap B (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))).comp π =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (algebraMap A C)) :
    IsStrictHenselization B L (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))

Ideal.le_comap_map proves the kernel inclusion, and liftOfSurjective_comp_apply proves the hcomp equation required upstream. Applying the upstream theorem and packaging these explicitly constructed structures proves the original node statement.
